practicalCriteria: Every one of the 24 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
The reserved team hours, the team size and the extra-time rule are all stated, and the agreement does not promise a result
Each notice period is a whole number of days that matches the business's own roster, with the reason recorded
Each payment, debt, liability and insurance statement has a recorded check, or has been removed
Each insurance policy and licence listed has a document the business holds, with its number and expiry date
Version issued to the client contains only sourced points
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: not applicable: document-only lesson, no field work
